name: The Alan Price Rhythm and Blues Combo

podcast.title: Club a Go-Go Residency
podcast.body: This group formed as a side project by members of The Contours and became the resident band at Newcastle's Club a Go-Go, a notable venue for touring American blues players and London jazzmen. "A few members of the Contours got a side gig, performing as the Alan Price rhythm and blues combo, as the resident band, at a local venue called the Club of Go-Go"

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Precursor to The Animals
podcast.body: In September 1963, this combo solidified its lineup, which would soon become The Animals, featuring Eric Burden on vocals, Alan Price on piano, John Steele on drums, Charles Chandler on bass, and Hilton Valentine on guitar. "in September 1963, the Alan Price rhythm and blues combo settled on a lineup of Bird and On vocals, Price on piano, Steel on drums, Chandler on bass, and new member Hilton Valentine, who joined at the same time as Steel, on guitar."
